---
title: Budget and Revenue
---



Film budgets and worldwide box office revenue. @fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between them.


::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
